title: U2OS focus z-stacks (BBBC006)
description: 285 two-channel z-stacks of U2OS cells (520 x 520 px, uint16), grouped by how far the stack sits from the focal plane: far below, below, near and far above focus.

title: Confocal multi-channel 3D kidney
description: Confocal microscopy volumes with mixed data types (uint8 and uint16) and a varying number of dimensions.
credit: Carlos Cordero, Sarah Wendlinger, Michael Kaminski

title: Mouse whole brain
description: Three whole-brain OME-Zarr volumes with 1,950 z-planes of roughly 9,000 x 7,400 px each (1.8 x 1.8 x 4 µm voxels, uint16), imaged in three channels: NeuN, cFOS and tdTomato.

title: Zooplankton images (ZooScan, Point B)
description: 55,338 grayscale uint8 images from a ZooScan at Point B (WP2 net, 200 µm), recorded through 2016, at 10.6 µm per pixel. Image sizes vary widely. Used as training data for a foundation model.
credit: Peter Hirsch, Nick Lechtenbörger and the AqQua team
